name: Orodes II
role: King of Kings of the Parthian Empire
contribution: King of Kings, Arsaces, Great King.
legacy: The victory at Carrhae secured for the Parthians the lands east of the Euphrates.

checks.lead: Orodes II (also spelled Urud II; Parthian: 𐭅𐭓𐭅𐭃 Wērōd), was King of Kings of the Parthian Empire from 57 BC to 37 BC. He was a son of Phraates III, whom he murdered in 57 BC, assisted by his elder brother Mithridates IV. The two brothers quickly fell out and entered into a dynastic struggle, in which Orodes was triumphant.
